svg.title: Odd-order rigidity gives one common rotation
svg.desc: Two circles of radius three show a schematic triple of polynomial values. At P equals one the points are c equals three, d equals minus three, and g equals three i. At P equals omega every point has been multiplied by omega, a counterclockwise rotation of 120 degrees. Their relative positions remain unchanged, while R and W equal one. These illustrative values do not constitute a Hadamard construction.
svg.text: The same angle carries each point from the left circle to the right circle.
The three points stay separate; their relative positions are preserved.
Schematic illustration of the conclusion, not an order-36 Hadamard construction.
